sections.description: Turn a WordPress/WooCommerce site into the storefront for a full booking-and-payment platform: embed the live catalog, tour pages, trip planner and gift-card designer (as Elementor widgets, shortcodes or blocks), drop SEO-friendly synced tour sections, and take payments through a secure WooCommerce gateway with deposit support — all without card data or checkout logic ever touching WordPress.
sections.changelog:
0.13.1

  • Analytics bridge follows GTM4WP (Google Tag Manager for WordPress) automatically: with GTM4WP active and "dataLayer only" selected it pushes to the dataLayer variable configured in GTM4WP (1.x and 2.x), and the Analytics screen shows the detected GTM4WP version, container id and dataLayer name.

0.13.0

  • New: Analytics bridge (Settings → WNC Pay Analytics) — the platform's GA4-style events fired inside the embedded frames (view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout, purchase, generate_lead, whatsapp_click…) are pushed onto this site's dataLayer so the site's own GTM container fires GA4 / Google Ads tags for them. Works with GTM4WP / Site Kit (dataLayer only) or injects the container itself. Per-group filters, custom dataLayer name, ?wncpay_debug=1 console logging.
  • New: attribution passthrough — gclid / gbraid / wbraid, UTM tags and the GA4 client + session id are handed to the frames (page-cache safe) so the platform's server-side purchases are attributed to the ad click.
  • New: "Marketing / SEO (WNC Pay)" role — an external SEO person can manage only the analytics screen.

0.11.9

  • Fix: embeds no longer show "This section could not load" over a working catalog/tour frame on cold loads of a heavy page. The failover cancels as soon as the frame loads (not only on its resize handshake) and its timeout is raised 10s to 20s; only a frame that never loads still falls back.

0.11.8

  • Docs: the plugin listing now fully explains what WNC Pay does and lists every current element. No functional change.

0.11.7

  • Hebrew/RTL header fix — the account icon no longer wraps the header onto a second line.
  • Headers without a cart widget (e.g. the Hebrew site) get an injected cart icon with a live count badge, opening the platform quote cart.

0.11.6

  • Cart icon capture now works on every page of the site (previously only on pages with an embed); the count badge remembers its value site-wide.

0.11.5

  • Bug fixes (in-page links inside embeds now scroll the page correctly).

0.11.4

  • Bug fixes.

0.11.3

  • Bug fixes.

0.11.2

  • New: header login icon — a small account icon in the site header linking to the customer's account on the platform (Settings → WNC Pay).

0.11.1

  • Bug fixes.

0.11.0

  • New: capture the site's cart icon — clicking it opens the platform quote cart, and its count badge mirrors the visitor's quote (Settings → WNC Pay → Cart icon, off by default).

0.10.x

  • Tour pages flow inside the site page (site header above, site footer after the content — no separate scrolling).
  • Popups (quote cart, forms) open reliably above the whole page.
  • Pages open at the top after in-frame navigation.
  • Hardened updates: a partially copied update can no longer take the site down.
  • Bug fixes.

0.9.0

  • New: floating “Gift this adventure” button on tour pages, opening the gift-card designer with the tour preselected (Settings → WNC Pay).
  • New: server-rendered tour sections for Elementor pages, with a tour picker in the page list's Quick Edit.

0.8.1

  • Catalog docks flush under the site menu when scrolling pauses near it — one scroll context instead of two competing ones; the rest of the page stays reachable.

0.8.0

  • New shortcodes: [wncpay_tour id] (single tour page), [wncpay_how_it_works], [wncpay_pay reference]. mode="window|auto" attribute on every shortcode. Full shortcode reference table added to Settings → WNC Pay.

0.7.5

  • Context-aware catalog: the embed learns which site page the visitor came from and opens the matching tour directly, or pre-filters to the matching category. Same-site referrers only.

0.7.4

  • Individual tour pages opened from the embedded catalog take the whole screen while viewed; Back returns to the catalog and restores the window.

0.7.3

  • Embed forms/popups (quote basket, request form, previews) expand the frame full-screen while open, so they stack above the site menu and floating buttons; the frame restores on close.

0.7.2

  • Tour catalog embeds in window mode: the frame fills the visitor's screen below the site menu and the catalog scrolls inside it — sticky toolbar with zero lag, cart and popups open centered. mode="auto" on the shortcode restores full-height mode.

0.7.1

  • Embeds stream their frame's viewport position into the platform page so embedded toolbars can pin themselves below the site's menu while scrolling. Purely visual; nothing to configure.

0.7.0

  • TEST payments (gateway Test mode or the magic test ID at checkout) now stamp the WooCommerce order with a TEST note and meta — test orders can never be mistaken for real revenue.

0.6.0

  • New embeds: [wncpay_trip_planner] (trip-builder wizard) and [wncpay_tour_catalog] (multi-tour interactive catalog) — host the platform inside the site.
  • Cross-site failover: a blocked embed swaps itself for an 'Open in a new tab' card instead of a blank frame.

0.5.0

  • Test mode (gateway setting): checkouts are sent as TEST transactions — processed against the PayMe sandbox, the PayMe test card approves for real, no actual money moves, everything is stamped [TEST] on the platform and excluded from revenue and the CRM. A yellow TEST banner shows at checkout while enabled. Turn OFF before go-live.

0.4.0

  • Deposit flow (configurable %, default 30) for tours pending office availability confirmation, with checkout stipulation; order completes when the balance webhook arrives.
  • Per-product "full payment" checkbox for instant items.
  • Required preferred-date question at checkout for tour items.

0.3.6

  • Traveller count sent with each gateway order (Appointments persons or quantities) — fills the CRM deal's Amount of People automatically.

0.3.5

  • Full shortcode reference + examples on Settings → WNC Pay.
  • Fix: dealid shortcode attribute now reaches the platform correctly.

0.3.4

  • Multi-item carts use the platform's multiple-tours document variant.

0.3.3

  • Order-received page + customer emails link to the platform account after a WNC Pay payment.

0.3.2

  • Brand logo across the gateway checkout, settings page and update screens.

0.3.0

  • WooCommerce payment gateway: appears under WooCommerce → Settings → Payments; checkout redirects to the platform's secure payment page; orders completed by signed platform webhooks. ILS carts, HPOS compatible.
  • Connection status indicator on Settings → WNC Pay.

0.2.0

  • Native WordPress updates via the public wncpay-update channel.

0.1.0

  • First release: settings page, embed core with auto-height and WPML-aware locale, Gift Card Designer as Elementor widget + shortcode + block.
